headline: Reranking Gateway architecture
linkedin_post:
🚀 Just shipped the 'Reranking Gateway' for our Governed Enterprise RAG pipeline.

The Problem: Initial retrieval is fast but noisy. We need precision without sacrificing latency.

The Solution: A componentized reranking service that sits between retrieval and generation.

Key Design Choices:
✅ Hybrid Approach: Cross-Encoders for accuracy on top-K, Bi-Encoders for scale.
✅ Governance First: Policy checks run before/after reranking to ensure compliance.
✅ Resilience: Circuit breakers prevent model latency from crashing the user experience.

Why it matters: In enterprise AI, 'good enough' retrieval leads to hallucination. Reranking is the critical filter for trust.

#AI #RAG #EnterpriseAI #SystemDesign #MLOps

specification.description: A modular, high-throughput gateway service that intercepts initial RAG retrieval results, applies a cross-encoder or dense-retrieval reranker, and returns re-ordered candidates with confidence scores. Designed for governed enterprise environments requiring auditability and low-latency fallbacks.
failure_modes: Model latency > SLA threshold: Trigger fallback to initial retrieval order.
Model crash: Return empty list with error code 503.
Input validation failure: Return 400 Bad Request.
specification.name: Reranking Gateway (Refined)

takeaway: Reranking is not just an optimization; it is a governance and reliability layer. By decoupling retrieval from reranking and implementing circuit breakers, enterprises can achieve high-precision answers without compromising system availability. The trade-off between Cross-Encoder accuracy and Bi-Encoder speed must be managed via hybrid architectures and caching strategies.
validation_method: External peer scores only (no self-scoring). Average of two anonymous reviews. Blockers for unsupported claims, fabricated references, critical security flaws. Model agreement alone does not certify correctness.
